options.name: account_id
options.description: Set the tenant for which Cloud is assigned to.

options.name: agent_mode
options.description: Agent Install Mode. V(cloudinit) and V(unattend) are the same. V(guestexec), V(ssh) and V(winrm) are the same.

options.name: appliance_url
options.description: URL of the Morpheus Appliance.

options.name: auto_recover_power_state
options.description: Automatically Power-on Virtual Machines.

options.name: code
options.description: The code to reference the Cloud for use in polcies etc.

options.name: costing_mode
options.description: Enable costing on the Cloud.

options.name: dark_logo
options.description: Path to an image file to use as the Cloud logo when in dark mode.

options.name: datacenter_name
options.description: Custom Datacenter Identifier.

options.name: description
options.description: Set the description of the Cloud.

options.name: enable_network_type_selection
options.description: Enable user to select the Network Interface type.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enable O(enabled=true) or Disable O(enabled=false) the Cloud.

options.name: force_remove
options.description: Force removal if Cloud is still in a group.

options.name: group_id
options.description: Set the Cloud Group this Cloud is a member of.

options.name: guidance_mode
options.description: Enable/Disable Cloud Guidance

options.name: id
options.description: Specify an existing Cloud to Update or Remove.

options.name: import_existing
options.description: Inventory Cloud and Import existing Virtual Machines.

options.name: location
options.description: Add location information for the Cloud.

options.name: logo
options.description: Path to an image file to use as the Cloud logo.

options.name: name
options.description: Set the name of the Cloud.

options.name: refresh_mode
options.description: The type of refresh to perform. V(costing) Pull costing data. V(costing_rebuild) Purge existing costing data and rebuild by calling the Cloud API. V(daily) Perform a daily Cloud Sync. V(hourly) Perform hourly Cloud Sync.

options.name: refresh_period
options.description: The invoice billing period to refresh. The value should be in the format of YYYYMM.

options.name: remove_resources
options.description: Relevant when O(state=absent), remove associated resources when removing the cloud. Includes removal of Virtual Machines and other forms of Compute.

options.name: scale_priority
options.description: Set Scale Priority.

options.name: security_mode
options.description: Host firewall.

options.name: state
options.description: Create, Update or Remove a Cloud.

options.name: timezone
options.description: The Time Zone of the Cloud.

options.name: visibility
options.description: Toggle tenant visibility between Private or Public.
